reasons: Both answers do the same core job: a shared helper, a 10s httpx timeout plus an asyncio.wait_for deadline, and ToolError on timeout. Both reprint the whole file and both open with a short summary and a caveat, so they score the same on the rubric. A has a slight edge on practical value: it also handles non-JSON responses, gives a quick way to test with JIRA_TIMEOUT=0.001, and notes that Jira keeps running the query server-side; B's structured-output rationale and status hints are useful but add less.
